requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan capabilities.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver superior productivity and ease of management for SMB customers, differentiating HP from competitors and addressing key customer needs for efficiency and ROI.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software development, integration with SMB portal, and hardware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print, Perfect Scan, manageability) are functional, user-tested, and available at launch; measurable improvement in workflow efficiency over previous HP models.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to achieve HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, including cost-efficient ink tank system and minimal intervention requirements.
requirements.Rationale: TCO is a top decision criterion for SMBs; achieving the lowest TCO will drive market adoption and competitiveness.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires optimized ink tank design, efficient consumables, and serviceability features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent cost analysis confirms Magellan has the lowest TCO among HP business printers for the SMB segment.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by customers without technical assistance, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT resources and require easy maintenance to minimize disruptions and costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for tool-less replacement and clear instructions; must meet warranty/service policies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by a non-technical user in under 5 minutes; validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated online portal for SMBs to manage multiple Magellan printers, including monitoring, configuration, and support functions.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/Lightly Managed SMBs need centralized, user-friendly management tools to reduce IT burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with AI solutions and telemetry; requires secure authentication and multi-device support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal enables management of at least 10 printers, supports all key functions, and passes usability and security reviews.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability Requirements
requirements.Description: Offer warranty coverage of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first). Ensure customer replaceable parts (PHA) and service center support for MINK, with a target to maximize customer replaceability.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and maintenance costs for SMBs, aligns with service expectations for the target segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durable components, clear replacement procedures, and supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy is published; customer replaceable parts are validated; service metrics meet targets.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces risk of user error and protects printer performance and warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle design changes and supply chain coordination.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are available at launch; field testing shows <1% misfill incidents.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL and PDL SKU Support
requirements.Description: Release both Non-PDL and PDL SKUs. Non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS. PDL SKU supports 25/20 ppm speed, PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses varied SMB customer requirements for print languages, speed, and compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires product differentiation, certification, and feature validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs are available at launch with specified features and certifications.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure at least 60% of the printer’s plastic content is from recycled sources, surpassing key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and customer requirement, especially for SMBs with ESG goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Material sourcing, supply chain adjustments, compliance with environmental standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and independent audit confirm 60% RCP in shipping units.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to support remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, usage insights, and continuous improvement for SMB customers and HP.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with SMB portal and privacy/compliance measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, securely transmitted, and accessible in the SMB portal; meets privacy regulations.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing via HP App and ensure compatibility with major mobile platforms.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile-first workflows are critical for SMBs; enhances convenience and productivity.
requirements.Dependencies: App development, platform certification, and user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing works with iOS and Android; validated by user testing and app store reviews.
